§ 헤더 2건 추가 (MSG ### 소제목): ch1 §2곳
paragraphs: § No Longer Giving God a Thought or a Prayer

Alright, so this is a message from God, and it's for this dude Zephaniah. He's the son of Cushi, who's the son of Gedaliah, who's the son of Amariah, who's the son of Hezekiah. This all went down when Josiah, son of Amon, was king of Judah.
God's dropping a decree, and it's intense. He's like, 'I'm about to totally wipe the earth clean, like a full-on deep clean.'
'I'm talking everyone and everything—dudes, girls, animals, even birds and fish. Anything that's causing people to mess up, it's gone. But yeah, especially the people.'

'I'm starting with Judah and everyone in Jerusalem. I'm gonna get rid of all the sketchy stuff, like those Baal shrines that mixed sex with religion, and their priests. And those people who sneak up to their rooftops at night to worship the star gods and goddesses? They're out. Same for the people who say they worship God but are also praying to other king-gods just in case. And don't even get me started on the ones who've totally dumped God and don't even give him a thought or a prayer anymore.'

'Yo, quiet now! Reverent silence before God, the Master. Time's up. Judgment Day is coming, for real. The Holy Day is set, and the guests are ready. On that day, I'm gonna deal with the leaders and the princes, and anyone dressing up like foreign priests and priestesses, bringing in their weird prayers and practices. And I'm gonna deal with everyone who's bringing in superstitions that are turning holy places into a mess. Judgment Day is coming, for real!' God's decree! 'You're gonna hear panic from the Fish Gate, screams from the Second Quarter, and crashing from the hills! All you shopkeepers on Market Street, you better cry, 'cause your money-making days are over. The god of money is dead. On Judgment Day, I'm gonna search every corner of Jerusalem. I'll find all those lazy people who are just sitting around, thinking, 'God doesn't do anything, good or bad. He's not involved, so why should we be?' But just you wait. They're gonna lose everything—their money, their houses, their land. They'll build houses and never live in them. They'll plant vineyards and never even get to taste the wine.'
§ A Day of Darkness at Noon

'The great Judgment Day of God is almost here. It's the final countdown... seven, six, five, four... It's gonna be a bitter and loud day, even the tough guys will be screaming for help. Judgment Day is payday—and I'm paying out my anger. It's gonna be a day of total chaos and pain, a day of darkness at noon, a day of black storm clouds, a day of bloodcurdling war cries as forts get attacked and defenses get smashed. I'm gonna make things so bad, people won't know what hit them. They'll be stumbling around like they're blind. They've sinned against God! Their blood will be poured out like dirty water, and their guts shoveled into slop buckets like trash. Don't even think about trying to buy your way out of this. Your money is worthless. This is the Day of God's Judgment—my anger! I care about sin with a fiery passion—a fire to burn up this corrupt world and finish off all the corrupt people in it.'

§ 헤더 2건 추가 (MSG ### 소제목)
paragraphs: § Seek God

Alright, listen up. You guys need to get it together, for real. You're a nation that's totally clueless. You better shape up before you get blown away like dust in the wind, before God's crazy anger hits you, before the final day of judgment goes down.
So look for God, all you humble people who actually follow his rules. Try to do what's right. Live a quiet, disciplined life. Maybe, just maybe, you'll get a pass on the day God's anger is unleashed.
§ All Earth-Made Gods Will Blow Away

Gaza is about to be totally wrecked. Ashdod is getting cleared out by noon. Ekron is getting ripped out from the ground up. It's the end for the people by the sea, the folks from Crete. God's word is bad news for you who live in Canaan, the land of the Philistines: 'You're getting destroyed. No one's gonna be left.'

The land by the sea will turn into a big pasture, a place for shepherds and their sheep. The survivors from Judah's family will get it all. They'll let their flocks graze by the sea during the day and then crash in Ashkelon at night. Their own God will watch out for them and make everything good again, just like before.

'I've heard all the nasty taunts from Moab, and the mockeries flung by Ammon. They've been talking cruel trash about my people and strutting around all self-important along Israel's borders. So, as sure as I'm the living God,' says the God-of-the-Angel-Armies, Israel's personal God, 'Moab is gonna end up a ruin like Sodom, and Ammon a ghost town like Gomorrah—one a field of rocks, the other a sterile salt flat, a moonscape forever. What's left of my people will finish them off, pick them clean, and take over. This is what they get for their bloated pride, for their taunts and mockeries of the people of the God-of-the-Angel-Armies. God will be seen as truly terrible—a Holy Terror. All the earth-made gods will shrivel up and blow away. And everyone, wherever they are, far or near, will fall to the ground and worship him. And yeah, you Ethiopians too—you're gonna die. I'll see to it.'

Then God's gonna reach into the north and destroy Assyria. He'll waste Nineveh, leaving her dry and treeless as a desert. That ghost town of a city, a haunt for wild animals—Nineveh will be home to raccoons and coyotes, bedding down in its ruins. Owls will hoot in the windows, ravens will croak in the doorways—all that fancy woodwork now just a perch for birds. Can this really be the famous Fun City that had it made, the one that boasted, 'I'm the Number-One City! I'm King of the Mountain!'? So why is the place deserted now, a lair for wild animals? Passersby hardly give it a look—they just dismiss it with a wave.

§ 헤더 3건 추가 (MSG ### 소제목)
paragraphs: § Sewer City

Man, it's over for that rebel city, the home of oppressors—Sewer City, for real. The city that wouldn't take advice, wouldn't accept correction, wouldn't trust God, wouldn't even get close to her own God! Her very own leaders are rapacious lions. Her judges are rapacious timber wolves, out every morning prowling for a fresh kill. Her prophets are out for whatever they can get—total opportunists. You can't trust them. Her priests desecrate the Sanctuary. They use God's law as a weapon to maim and kill souls. Yet God remains righteous in her midst, untouched by the evil. He stays at it, day after day, meting out justice. At evening he's still at it, strong as ever. But evil men and women, without conscience and without shame, just keep on persisting in evil.
God says, “I literally wiped out other nations. I tore down their defenses and trashed their streets so no one could pass. Their cities were left completely empty, total ghost towns.”

“I thought, ‘Surely she’ll honor me now, accept my discipline and correction, find a way out of the trouble she’s in, find relief from the punishment I’m bringing.’ But it didn’t faze her. Bright and early she was up at it again, doing the same old things.”

God's decree: “Well, if that's what you want, stick around. Your day in court is coming, but remember—I'll be there with the evidence. I'll bring all the nations to the courtroom, round up all the kingdoms, and let them feel the brunt of my anger, my raging wrath. My zeal is a fire that will purge and purify the earth.”
§ God Is in Charge at the Center

“But in the end, I'm gonna turn things around for the people. I'll give them a language undistorted, unpolluted—words to address God in worship and, united, to serve me with their shoulders to the wheel. They'll come from beyond the Ethiopian rivers, they'll come praying—all my scattered, exiled people will come home with offerings for worship. You'll no longer have to be ashamed of all those acts of rebellion. I'll have gotten rid of your arrogant leaders. No more pious strutting on my holy hill! I'll leave a core of people among you who are poor in spirit—what's left of Israel, the real Israel. They'll make their home in God. This core holy people will not do wrong. They won't lie, won't use words to flatter or seduce. Content with who they are and where they are, unanxious, they'll live at peace.”

So sing, Daughter Zion! Raise your voices, Israel! Daughter Jerusalem, be happy! celebrate! God has reversed his judgments against you and sent your enemies off chasing their tails. From now on, God is Israel's king, in charge at the center. There's nothing to fear from evil ever again!
§ God Is Present Among You

Jerusalem will be told: “Don’t be afraid. Dear Zion, don’t despair. Your God is present among you, a strong Warrior there to save you. Happy to have you back, he'll calm you with his love and delight you with his songs.”

“The accumulated sorrows of your exile will dissipate. I, your God, will get rid of them for you. You've carried those burdens long enough. At the same time, I'll get rid of all those who've made your life miserable. I'll heal the maimed; I'll bring home the homeless. In the very countries where they were hated, they will be venerated. On Judgment Day I'll bring you back home—a great family gathering! You'll be famous and honored all over the world. You'll see it with your own eyes—all those painful partings turned into reunions!” That's God's promise.
